name: Vegetarian Niçoise Salad with Lemony Chickpeas & Dijon Vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg new potatoes
3 lemons
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
0.68 kg green beans
3 (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Halve potatoes and transfer to a large pot. Cover with hot water (from the tap), season with salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas; transfer to a medium bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the chickpeas; add turmeric and salt. Stir to combine and set aside to marinate.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp turmeric
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the pot is boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook until the potatoes are almost tender, about 10 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp white wine vinegar
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve tomatoes and thinly slice olives; transfer both to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
When the potatoes are almost done, add green beans and edamame; continue to cook, until veggies are fork-tender, 7-8 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water.
Transfer green beans, edamame, potatoes, and marinated chickpeas to the bowl with the dressing. Add mixed greens and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy.
